summary: Iteration 13 — Web Push (VAPID) endpoints, audit_code enrichment, dashboard KPI drill-down + SV status pills. Backend pytest: 12/13 new pass, 40/40 regression pass. Frontend P3 + P2 UI all wired correctly. ONE CRITICAL backend bug uncovered: VAPID private key is persisted in PKCS8 PEM format but py-vapid 1.9.4 only accepts SEC1 EC PEM — every web-push attempt fails at key deserialization BEFORE the HTTP call, so the 404/410 cull path never executes and real push delivery is impossible.

critical.issue: VAPID private key stored as PKCS8 PEM ('-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'); py-vapid 1.9.4 ecdsa.SigningKey.from_pem() rejects PKCS8 with 'ASN.1 parsing error: invalid length'. Every pywebpush.webpush() call throws ValueError BEFORE making the HTTP request — so (1) no notification is ever delivered and (2) the WebPushException 404/410 cull branch never runs. Confirmed by reproducing Vapid.from_string(stored_pem) → same error. Fix: in _vapid_generate_keypair() change PrivateFormat.PKCS8 → PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL (produces '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----'), then delete db.app_settings doc id='vapid' to force regeneration.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in some select — unrelated to this iteration.

Verify by re-running test_push_test_culls_fake_subscription — the fake FCM endpoint should now reach the network, return 404, and be culled.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes VAPID PEM format, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_push_and_activity.py — the only failing test (TestPushTest::test_push_test_culls_fake_subscription) should turn green AND TestEngineerSubmitTriggersPush will no longer skip if you confirm engineer has a project assignment. The bug is reproducible standalone: run `python3 -c "from py_vapid import Vapid; Vapid.from_string(open('pem').read())"` against any PKCS8 PEM — same ASN.1 error.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8 emits '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' (RFC 5208 PKCS#8). py-vapid 1.9.4 calls ecdsa.SigningKey.from_pem(), which only parses SEC1 ('-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----', RFC 5915). Reproduction: 1) curl /api/push/subscribe with a real ECDH P-256 p256dh + a 404-prone FCM endpoint; 2) curl /api/push/test → response says sent:0,total:1 but backend.err.log shows 'web push send failed: Could not deserialize key data ... ASN.1 parsing error: invalid length'; 3) /api/push/status count still shows the dead sub. MITIGATION: In server.py:_vapid_generate_keypair, replace `format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8` with `format=serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL`. Then either drop and regenerate app_settings.id='vapid', or write a one-shot migration that converts the existing PKCS8 PEM in-place to SEC1 (load with cryptography, re-serialize). After fix verify with the existing pytest: TestPushTest::test_push_test_culls_fake_subscription must pass (count drops to baseline after /push/test 404).
